description: This file is a script for checking web search provider boundary inventory in a codebase. It imports utility modules, defines functions to scan files, collect inventory data, compare inventories, and run boundary checks, primarily focusing on identifying web search provider configurations and their boundaries within the project.

methods.name: walkFiles
methods.description: Recursively walks through directories to list files with specific extensions, ignoring certain directories.

methods.name: compareInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries for sorting purposes.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an inventory entry after validating the provider ID.

methods.name: scanWebSearchProviderRegistry
methods.description: Scans lines of a file to identify web search provider registrations and imports.

methods.name: scanGenericCoreImports
methods.description: Scans lines of a file for imports related to web search providers outside allowed files.

methods.name: collectWebSearchProviderBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Collects inventory data on web search provider boundaries across project files.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the expected inventory JSON file.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes differences between expected and actual inventories.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats inventory data into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry into a string.

methods.name: runWebSearchProviderBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the boundary check process comparing actual and expected inventories.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to execute the boundary check script.
